issuing_authority.value: State Real Estate Commission / Department of State
issuing_authority.quote: It shall be the duty of the department to issue licenses and registration certificates to any person who shall comply with the provisions of this act.

name.quote: The State Real Estate Commission is hereby created

type.quote: The State Real Estate Commission is hereby created and shall consist of the Commissioner of Professional and Occupational Affairs; the Director of the Bureau of Consumer Protection, or his designee; three members who shall be persons representing the public at large; five other persons, each of whom shall at the time of his appointment be a licensed and qualified real estate broker

moral_character_required.quote: Licenses shall be granted only to and renewed only for persons who bear a good reputation for honesty, trustworthiness, integrity and competence to transact the business of broker

available.quote: Any person who holds a current license to provide real estate services issued by another state and whose principal place of business for the provision of those services is outside of this Commonwealth may be issued a reciprocal license under this act

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a current license in their home state, file an application with a certified copy of that license, a certified statement regarding disciplinary history, a verified statement of compliance, pay applicable fees, and consent to service of process.
requirements.quote: The commission shall issue a reciprocal license upon the filing with the commission of an application and the receipt of: a duly certified copy of a current license issued to the applicant by the state in which the principal place of business of the applicant is located

title_protection.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person, directly or indirectly, to engage in or conduct, or to advertise or hold himself out as engaging in or conducting the business, or acting in the capacity of a broker

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtained license by false representation or fraudulent act or conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: where the said license has been obtained by false representation, or by fraudulent act or conduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any substantial misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any substantial misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any false promise likely to influence a person to enter into a contract
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any false promise of a character likely to influence, persuade or induce any person to enter into any contract or agreement when he could not or did not intend to keep such promise.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pursuing a continued and flagrant course of misrepresentation or making false promises
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Pursuing a continued and flagrant course of misrepresentation or making of false promises through salesperson, associate broker, other persons, or any medium of advertising, or otherwise.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any misleading or untruthful advertising or using trade names of associations to which the licensee does not belong
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any misleading or untruthful advertising, or using any other trade name or insignia or membership in any real estate association or organization, of which the licensee is not a member.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with any of the requirements of section 608.5 (escrow/deposit handling)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to comply with any of the requirements of section 608.5.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to preserve for three years records relating to any real estate transaction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to preserve for three years following its consummation records relating to any real estate transaction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting for more than one party in a transaction without written knowledge and consent of all parties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting for more than one party in a transaction without the knowledge and consent in writing of all parties for whom he acts.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Placing a for sale or for rent sign on property without written consent of the owner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Placing a "for sale" or "for rent" sign on or advertising any property without the written consent of the owner, or his authorized agent.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to voluntarily furnish copies of listing, sale, lease or other contracts to all signatories at execution
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to voluntarily furnish a copy of any listing, sale, lease, or other contract relevant to a real estate transaction to all signatories thereof at the time of execution.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to specify a definite termination date in any listing contract
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to specify a definite termination date that is not subject to prior notice, in any listing contract.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inducing any party to break a contract for purposes of personal gain by the licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inducing any party to a contract, sale or lease to break such contract for the purpose of substitution in lieu thereof of a new contract, where such substitution is motivated by the personal gain of the licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Salesperson or associate broker accepting commission from any person other than the licensed broker with whom affiliated
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting a commission or any valuable consideration by a salesperson or associate broker for the performance of any acts specified in this act, from any person, except the licensed real estate broker with whom he is affiliated.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to disclose in writing to owner the licensee's intention to acquire an interest in a listed property
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to disclose to an owner in writing his intention or true position if he directly or indirectly through a third party, purchased for himself or acquires or intends to acquire any interest in or any option to purchase property which has been listed with his office to sell or lease.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of forgery, embezzlement, fraud, bribery, larceny, extortion, conspiracy to defraud, any felony, or pleading guilty or nolo contendere to such offenses
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted in a court of competent jurisdiction in this or any other state, or Federal court, of forgery, embezzlement, obtaining money under false pretenses, bribery, larceny, extortion, conspiracy to defraud, or any similar offense or offenses, or any felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any rule or regulation promulgated by the commission in the interest of the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any rule or regulation promulgated by the commission in the interest of the public and consistent with the provisions of this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide a disclosure required by this act or any other Federal or State law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to provide a disclosure required by this act or any other Federal or State law imposing a disclosure obligation on licensees in connection with real estate transactions.

disciplinary_grounds.description: In the case of a broker, failing to exercise adequate supervision over licensed salespersons or associate brokers
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In the case of a broker licensee, failing to exercise adequate supervision over the activities of his licensed salespersons or associate brokers within the scope of this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide information requested by the commission as the result of a formal or informal complaint
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing, within a reasonable time as defined by the commission, to provide information requested by the commission as the result of a formal or informal complaint to the commission, which would indicate a violation of this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting, selling or offering for sale real property by offering free lots, conducting lotteries, or offering prizes to influence purchasers through deceptive conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Soliciting, selling or offering for sale real property by offering free lots, or conducting lotteries or contests or offering prizes for the purpose of influencing by deceptive conduct any purchaser or prospective purchaser of real property.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying or accepting any undisclosed commission, rebate, compensation or profit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Paying or accepting, giving or charging any undisclosed commission, rebate, compensation or profit or expenditures for a principal, or in violation of this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any conduct in a real estate transaction that demonstrates bad faith, dishonesty, untrustworthiness, or incompetency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conduct in a real estate transaction which demonstrates bad faith, dishonesty, untrustworthiness, or incompetency.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing any act for which a real estate license is required when one is not currently in effect
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing any act for which an appropriate real estate license is required and is not currently in effect.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the Pennsylvania Human Relations Act or any order or consent decree of the Pennsylvania Human Relations Commission
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of the act of October 27, 1955 (P.L.744, No.222), known as the "Pennsylvania Human Relations Act," or any order or consent decree of the Pennsylvania Human Relations Commission

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating sections 606 or 607 (relationship and disclosure provisions)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating section 606 or 607.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating section 609 (right to cancel time share and campground membership purchases)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating section 609.

disciplinary_grounds.description: In the case of a broker, failing to exercise adequate supervision over campground membership or time-share salespersons
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In the case of a broker licensee, failing to exercise adequate supervision over the activities of a campground membership salesperson or a time-share salesperson within the scope of this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having been disciplined under a real estate licensing law of another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having been disciplined under a real estate licensing law of another jurisdiction, including, but not limited to, having a license suspended or revoked, a fine or penalty imposed or being censured or reprimanded publicly or privately

disciplinary_grounds.description: Owning an interest in a qualified association that participates in prohibited acts, is not solely owned by affiliated licensees, or holds itself out as providing real estate services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Owning an interest in a qualified association that does any of the following: (i) Participates in any of the prohibited acts under this subsection. (ii) Is not solely owned by licensees who are all affiliated with the same broker. (iii) Holds itself out to the public as providing real estate services or real estate-related services.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating section 602 (reciprocal license requirements)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating section 602.

definition_quote.value: Any person who, for another and for a fee, commission or other valuable consideration: (i) negotiates with or aids any person in locating or obtaining for purchase, lease or an acquisition of interest in any real estate; (ii) negotiates the listing, sale, purchase, exchange, lease, time share and similarly designated interests, financing or option for any real estate; (iii) manages any real estate; (iv) represents himself to be a real estate consultant, counsellor, agent or finder; (v) undertakes to promote the sale, exchange, purchase or rental of real estate; (vi) undertakes to perform a comparative market analysis; or (vii) attempts to perform any of the above acts.
definition_quote.quote: Any person who, for another and for a fee, commission or other valuable consideration: (i) negotiates with or aids any person in locating or obtaining for purchase, lease or an acquisition of interest in any real estate; (ii) negotiates the listing, sale, purchase, exchange, lease, time share and similarly designated interests, financing or option for any real estate; (iii) manages any real estate; (iv) represents himself to be a real estate consultant, counsellor, agent or finder; (v) undertakes to promote the sale, exchange, purchase or rental of real estate; (vi) undertakes to perform a comparative market analysis; or (vii) attempts to perform any of the above acts.

broker_of_record_required.quote: If the applicant for a broker's license is a corporation, partnership or association, then the provisions of sections 511 and 512 shall apply to the individual designated as broker of record.

pre_exam_experience_years.quote: The applicant shall have been engaged as a licensed real estate salesperson for at least three years or possess educational or experience qualifications which the commission deems to be the equivalent thereof.

pre_exam_instruction_hours.quote: The applicant shall have completed 240 hours in real estate instruction in areas of study prescribed by the rules of the commission

required_instruction_topics.quote: which rules shall require instruction in the areas of fair housing and professional ethics.

exam_application_window_years.quote: The application shall be received by the commission within three years of the date upon which the applicant passed the examination.

inactive_license_max_years.quote: That a licensee who fails to activate his license after five years must retake the appropriate examination.

license_revocation_reapplication_waiting.quote: the commission shall not reinstate the license, within five years of the date of revocation, of any person whose license has been revoked under this act.

agency_relationship_types.quote: A broker may act in a real estate transaction, subject to the provisions of this act, as a seller/landlord agent, buyer/tenant agent, as a dual agent for seller/landlord and buyer/tenant or as a transaction licensee.

dual_agency_written_consent_required.quote: A licensee may act as a dual agent only with the written consent of both parties to the transaction following the disclosures given at the initial interview required by section 608.

designated_agency_permitted.quote: a broker, including one serving as a dual agent, may designate a licensee to act exclusively as agent of a particular seller/landlord and may designate another licensee to act exclusively as agent of a particular buyer/tenant.

transaction_licensee_role_permitted.quote: A licensed broker or salesperson who provides communication or document preparation services or performs acts described under the definition of "broker" or "salesperson" for which a license is required, without being an agent or advocate of the consumer.

initial_interview_disclosure_required.quote: the commission shall establish rules or regulations which shall set forth the manner and method of disclosure of information to the prospective buyer/tenant or seller/landlord during the initial interview.

written_service_agreement_required.quote: A licensee may not perform a service for a consumer of real estate services for a fee, commission or other valuable consideration paid by or on behalf of the consumer unless the nature of the service and the fee to be charged are set forth in a written agreement between the broker and the consumer that is signed by the consumer.

value: capacity in which the broker is engaged in the transaction and whether affiliated licensee provided services to any other party

sales_contract_mandatory_disclosures.quote: In a sales agreement or sales contract, a broker shall disclose the following information: (1) A statement identifying the capacity in which the broker is engaged in the transaction ... (2) A statement describing the purpose of the Real Estate Recovery Fund ... (3) A statement of the zoning classification of the property ... (4) A statement that access to a public road may require issuance of a highway occupancy permit

listing_contract_termination_date_requir.quote: Failing to specify a definite termination date that is not subject to prior notice, in any listing contract.

transaction_record_retention_years.quote: Failing to preserve for three years following its consummation records relating to any real estate transaction.

escrow_account_required.quote: A broker must deposit moneys and property of whatever kind or nature, belonging to others, in a separate custodial or trust fund account maintained by the broker with a bank or recognized depository by the end of the business day following their receipt by the broker.

escrow_deposit_deadline_business_days.quote: A broker must deposit moneys and property of whatever kind or nature, belonging to others, in a separate custodial or trust fund account maintained by the broker with a bank or recognized depository by the end of the business day following their receipt by the broker.

commingling_of_funds_prohibited.quote: A broker shall not commingle deposits or other escrows or property of another person with the broker's own funds or property.

fixed_office_required.quote: Each broker (which term in this section shall include cemetery broker) and rental listing referral agent who holds a standard license shall maintain a fixed office within this Commonwealth.

branch_office_associate_broker_required.quote: Each office shall be under the direction and supervision of a manager who is either the broker or an associate broker

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: No associate broker or salesperson (which term in this section shall include cemetery salesperson) shall be employed by any other broker than is designated upon the current license issued to said associate broker or said salesperson.

qualified_association_permitted.quote: it is not unlawful for a broker to pay a commission or compensation to a qualified association or for an associate broker or salesperson to receive a commission or compensation for the provision of real estate services or real estate-related services from a qualified association in which the associate broker or salesperson owns an interest.

recovery_fund_exists.quote: There is hereby established the Real Estate Recovery Fund for the purposes hereinafter set forth in this act.

recovery_fund_max_per_claim.quote: the liability of that portion of the fund allocated for the purpose of this act shall not exceed $20,000 for any one claim

promotional_land_sales_registration_requ.quote: Any person who proposes to engage in real estate transactions of a promotional nature in this Commonwealth for a property located inside or outside of this Commonwealth, shall first register with the commission for its approval before so doing

time_share_cancellation_right_days.quote: A purchaser shall have the right to cancel the purchase of a time share or a campground membership until midnight of the fifth day following the date on which the purchaser executed the purchase contract.

wholesale_transaction_cancellation_right.quote: A consumer who is party to a wholesale transaction shall have the right to cancel a sales agreement or sales contract that contains the information required under subsection (e) until midnight of the 30th day after the date when the consumer executed the agreement or contract, or until conveyance, whichever occurs first.

broker_price_opinion_permitted.quote: A broker price opinion may be prepared by a broker, associate broker or salesperson only for use in conjunction with: (1) a property owned by a lender after an unsuccessful sale at a foreclosure auction; (2) a modification of a first or junior mortgage or equity line of credit; (3) a short sale of a property; or (4) an evaluation or monitoring of a portfolio of properties.

comparative_market_analysis_permitted.quote: A comparative market analysis must contain the following statement printed conspicuously and without change on the first page: This analysis has not been performed in accordance with the Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal Practice
